type: ({ seconds, paused, onComplete, label, announcement, className, }: CountdownProps) => JSX.Element
description:
A ring and a label for an auto-start or undo window (spec section 11). A
one-second timer counts down while not paused. Its sentence is announced
once, never per tick.

parameters.name:
{
  seconds,
  paused = false,
  onComplete,
  label,
  announcement = "polite",
  className = "",
}

announcement.description: Off when the owner pattern announces the countdown itself.

label.description: The sentence around the time left, «خلال ٥ث» / "in 5s" by default.

paused.description: Stops the count; it resumes from the time left.

seconds.description: Whole seconds to count down from.
